nodes.description: Private address state variable holding the current owner of Ownable/MedianOracle.
Public address[] array of authorized report providers.
Mapping (address => Report[2]) storing the two most recent reports per provider.
Public uint256, seconds after which a report is deemed expired.
Public uint256, seconds that must pass since reporting before a report is usable.
Public uint256, minimum number of valid reports required for a valid aggregate.
Private constant uint256 upper bound (520 weeks) for the report expiration period.
internal pure mul(uint256 a, uint256 b): multiplication with overflow revert.
internal pure div(uint256 a, uint256 b): division, reverts on divide by zero.
internal pure sub(uint256 a, uint256 b): subtraction, reverts on underflow.
internal pure add(uint256 a, uint256 b): addition, reverts on overflow.
internal pure mod(uint256 a, uint256 b): modulo, reverts when b == 0.
Ownable constructor: sets _owner to msg.sender and emits OwnershipTransferred.
public view owner(): returns the current _owner address.
public view isOwner(): returns msg.sender == _owner.
public onlyOwner renounceOwnership(): sets _owner to address(0).
public onlyOwner transferOwnership(address newOwner): delegates to _transferOwnership.
internal _transferOwnership(address newOwner): validates and writes _owner.
internal pure computeMedian(uint256[] array, uint256 size): insertion-sorts the first size elements and returns the median.
MedianOracle constructor validating MAX_REPORT_EXPIRATION_TIME and minimumProviders_ > 0, then initializing configuration state.
external onlyOwner setter for reportExpirationTimeSec with MAX bound check.
external onlyOwner setter for reportDelaySec.
external onlyOwner setter for minimumProviders, requires value > 0.
external pushReport(uint256 payload): provider pushes a timestamped payload, rate limited by reportDelaySec and now.
external purgeReports(): invalidates the caller's two reports by setting timestamps to 1.
external getData(): aggregates valid provider reports using now-based validity windows and returns (median, valid).
external onlyOwner addProvider(address provider): whitelists a provider and initializes its report slot.
external onlyOwner removeProvider(address provider): deletes reports and removes the provider from the array.
external view providersSize(): returns providers.length.
Untrusted caller address used for ownership initialization (Ownable constructor) and ownership/authorization checks (isOwner, onlyOwner).
Untrusted caller address used as provider identity in pushReport and purgeReports to index providerReports.
block.timestamp (now) used in pushReport both for the reportDelaySec rate-limit check and for writing the new report timestamp.
block.timestamp (now) used in getData to derive min/max valid report timestamps (timestamp dependency).
Raw multiplication a * b in SafeMath.mul followed by the c / a == b overflow assertion.
Raw division a / b in SafeMath.div guarded by require(b > 0).
Raw subtraction a - b in SafeMath.sub guarded by require(b <= a).
Raw addition a + b in SafeMath.add guarded by require(c >= a).
Raw modulo a % b in SafeMath.mod guarded by require(b != 0).
Indexing and median arithmetic in computeMedian (array[size/2].add(array[size/2-1]) / 2 and bubble-sort swaps).
Rate-limit comparison timestamps[index_recent].add(reportDelaySec) <= now, a timestamp-dependent access condition.
Computation of minValidTimestamp = now.sub(reportExpirationTimeSec) and maxValidTimestamp = now.sub(reportDelaySec), a timestamp-dependent validity window.
Privileged write to the _owner state variable (constructor, renounceOwnership); protected by onlyOwner for renunciation.
onlyOwner authorization gate (require(isOwner())) applied to all privileged external functions.
onlyOwner state mutation registering a provider: providers.push plus providerReports timestamp initialization.
onlyOwner state mutation removing a provider: delete of providerReports and providers.length decrement.
Write of reports[index_past].timestamp = now and reports[index_past].payload = payload into providerReports.
Write setting both providerReports[caller][i].timestamp = 1, invalidating the caller's reports.
Privileged ownership transfer write _owner = newOwner inside _transferOwnership.
